why: No data state: the disagreement is arity, which PostgreSQL settles by RowDescription without executing the body.

TestFuncSelectBlog.note: sqlc's IR carries one column named after the function; PostgreSQL's prepared-statement result_types carries four (integer, text, timestamp, timestamp), and EXPLAIN VERBOSE lists id, name, created_at, updated_at. Specific to RETURNS TABLE — OUT parameters and RETURNS SETOF <table> both expand correctly on v1.31.1.
